name: save_data
title: Create or update a data set
description: Creates a new data set or updates an existing one. The data set is given in the openLCA JSON-LD format (olca-schema) and must contain the @type attribute. If no @id is given, a new one is generated. If a data set with the given @id exists, it is replaced completely by the given data: to update a data set, get it first, modify it, and save the complete data set. References to other data sets are given as objects with @type and @id, e.g. {"@type": "Flow", "@id": "..."}; these data sets must exist in the database. Categories are given as paths, e.g. "category": "Materials/Metals", and are created if they do not exist. Returns a reference to the saved data set.

data.description: The data set in openLCA JSON-LD format, including @type.
